unruled:aqee#1.evidence: i8863 p. 4, Student qualifications, items 6 and 7. The student test requires dependent.edu_1098t / person.edu_1098t (Form 1098-T received, or the stated exceptions and the request-and-cooperate procedure), reached through dependent.edu_student_tin / person.edu_student_tin; the American opportunity test ends in dependent.edu_aoc_tin / person.edu_aoc_tin, which requires dependent.edu_ein / person.edu_ein (the institution's EIN). aqee is a def evaluated only through dependent.edu_line30 / person.edu_line30, which take line30 only when edu_aoc is true.

unruled:aqee#2.evidence: i8863 pp. 4, 9 (as the earlier aqee#3 ruling, rechecked). The def computes both paths, but the callers choose: dependent.edu_line30 takes line30 only when dependent.edu_aoc, and dependent.edu_line31 takes ws4_llc only when dependent.edu_llc ('edu_student true and edu_aoc false'); the same holds for person.edu_line30/31. So a student never has both lines 30 and 31.

unruled:aqee#3.evidence: i8863 pp. 4, 9 (as the earlier aqee#1 ruling, rechecked). aqee.inst is bound from dependent.edu_inst / person.edu_inst, whose question says 'paid in 2025 for this student, by anyone', 'for academic periods beginning in 2025 or in the first 3 months of 2026', excludes 'amounts paid in 2024 or 2026', room and board, insurance, 'medical expenses (including student health fees)', transportation, 'expenses deducted elsewhere', and sports, games, hobby or noncredit courses with the degree-program and (for the lifetime learning credit only) job-skills exceptions; aqee.mat (dependent.edu_mat) applies 'the same exclusions'.

unruled:asset#1.evidence: i4562 p. 3, listed property exceptions. As the earlier asset#1 ruling, rechecked against asset.listed: the computer exception applies only to computers placed in service before 2018, which are past their 5-year recovery in 2025 (pre-2005 property, ADS and other methods are refused by asset.screen), and the employee/employer-establishment rule concerns an employee's property, not a Schedule C proprietor's own establishment; neither changes an amount here.

unruled:asset#2.evidence: i4562 p. 7, Election out, "attach a statement to your timely filed return". asset.bonus_choice records the election (none/forty) and asset.bonus_same with asset.bonus_mixed refuses a choice that differs within a class; the attached statement is filing information, and the late election on an amended return under section 301.9100-2 is outside an original-return tool.

unruled:carloan#1.evidence: i1040gi pp. 109-110. The VIN on Schedule 1-A line 22, the substitute VIN and the statement for more than two VINs are filing information; the loan and vehicle tests are asked (carloan.requirements, carloan.vehicle). [Restamped unchanged from the ruling of earlier claim #1 under prompt_sha 51ebf755: same form, same quoted text, same cited page, same item and effect.]

unruled:clcw#1.evidence: i1040sd p. 10; p550 p. 102. Canceled debt excluded from income (Form 982) is refused by s1.cod_unsupported, so no attribute reduction of the carryovers arises. As sd#1 of the backlog round. [Restamped unchanged from the ruling of earlier claim #1 under prompt_sha dcf68a39: same form, same quoted text, same cited page, same item and effect.]

unruled:clcw26#1.evidence: p550 p. 103, 'can be deducted only on the final income tax return filed for the decedent' and 'The decedent's estate cannot deduct any of the loss or carry it over to following years'. Final returns are accepted (person.died_before_65; BUG-0087 notes final returns are in scope), but clcw26.line8 and clcw26.line13 show a carryover to 2026 on a final return and clcw26.decedent_notice fires only on a joint return for a spouse's losses. Executed: fixture stage20.mut.to2026_short_gain_long_loss (single) gives clcw26.line13 = $2,000 with decedent_notice false, and no question identifies a final return. Low; display-only (read by no other line).

unruled:dcprov#1.evidence: i2441 pp. 2-3. dcprov is a collection with any number of providers; the box above line 1, the statement for providers beyond three and 'none' in column (a) are filing information.

unruled:dcprov#2.evidence: i2441 p. 2. dependent.dc_paid excludes 'care at a dependent care center that does not meet all applicable state and local regulations'.

unruled:eic#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 43, "Check the box on line 27c if you do not want to claim the earned income credit". The filer's own choice not to claim is a recorded design limit: the eic.check_27c label says "the filer's own choice not to claim the EIC is not asked" and TASKS-DONE T-027 records it (the sibling line 28 choice was recorded the same way, BUG-0174). The claim reads the label correctly; no amount is wrong for a filer who claims the credit. [Restamped unchanged from the ruling of earlier claim #2 under prompt_sha b27e6543: same form, same quoted text, same cited page, same item and effect.]

unruled:eic#2.evidence: i1040gi p. 45, "if 'Valid for Work Only With DHS Authorization' is printed on your social security card, your SSN is valid for EIC purposes only as long as the DHS authorization is still valid". As the earlier eic#1 ruling: eic.step1_ssn reads household.all_eic_ssn, which counts person.eic_ssn of every person, and person.eic_ssn asks for an SSN "valid for the EIC" and says "a card that says 'Valid for Work Only With DHS Authorization' is valid only while the authorization is valid".

unruled:eic#3.evidence: i1040gi p. 47, "Don't include on these lines any statutory employee income, any net profit from services performed as a notary public, any amount exempt from self-employment tax as the result of ... Form 4029 or Form 4361". sc.statutory asks for statutory employee income or notary fees and sc.screened refuses the Schedule C; person.se_screen names an approved Form 4361 or 4029 and exempt self-employment income and person.se_screened refuses. Executed on stage14.eic.wsb_only_business: se_screen true refuses eic.wsb_se and f1040.line27a at person[taxpayer].se_screened, statutory true refuses them at sc[odd].screened. [Restamped unchanged from the ruling of earlier claim #6 under prompt_sha b27e6543: same form, same quoted text, same cited page, same item and effect.]

unruled:f1040#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 23, Chapter 11 Bankruptcy Cases, "Because this income is taxable to the estate, don't include this income on your own individual income tax return" and "you ... must allocate between you and the bankruptcy estate the wages ... reported to you on Form W-2". Only person.se_screen (Schedule SE) and the sc screens ask about a chapter 11 case; a wage-only debtor is asked nothing (scope.other_income says it is not about wages), so line 1a includes post-petition wages. Executed: stage8.single.phaseout.partial is accepted with line 1a $215,300, and person.se_screen true changes nothing. The other parts are handled: inmate wages (8u) and a nonqualified or section 457 pension (8t) are named in s1.line8_other, and a separate return in a community property state is refused (s3.mfs at scope.ready).

unruled:f1040#2.evidence: i1040gi pp. 24-25, 28. As the earlier f1040#1 ruling: scope.other_income names wages or tips not on a Form W-2 and other earned income (lines 1b to 1d and 1f to 1h) and refuses the return (executed: refuses f1040.line24 and scope.ready); disability pensions before minimum retirement age and corrective distributions are also named in retirement.special.

unruled:f1040#3.evidence: i1040gi pp. 27-28, Exceptions 2 to 4. As the earlier f1040#2 ruling: retirement.special names nondeductible traditional IRA contributions, conversions and recharacterizations (Form 8606), qualified charitable distributions and HSA funding distributions, and refuses the line 4b and 5b taxable amounts; a Roth IRA distribution other than code Q is refused by retirement.bad_code; the line 4c boxes and statement are filing information.

unruled:f1040#4.evidence: i1040gi pp. 28, 30. As the earlier f1040#3 ruling: retirement.special names "the retired public safety officer premium exclusion" and "a pension partly excludable because you were disabled as a result of a terrorist attack" and refuses the taxable amount; the line 5c box is filing information.

unruled:f1040#5.evidence: i1040gi p. 31, "your total repayments (box 4) were more than your total benefits for 2025 (box 3)" and the terrorist-attack disability payments. ssb.pub915 asks whether "your social security repayments in 2025 (box 4) were more than your benefits (box 3)" and ssb.terror_disability asks about the terrorist-attack payments; both refuse ssb.line2 and so lines 6a and 6b.

unruled:f1040#6.evidence: i1040gi p. 33, "check the box 'Schedule D not required' on line 7b". The checkbox is filing information; line 7a already carries the capital gain distributions and the box changes no amount.

unruled:f1040#7.evidence: i1040gi pp. 14, 33-34. As the earlier f1040#5 ruling: a married filing separately return is refused (s3.mfs at scope.ready, executed), so the spouse-itemizes and spouse-box rules do not arise; sa.unsupported names "a disaster loss added to the standard deduction" and refuses f1040.line12e (executed).

unruled:f1095a#1.evidence: i8962 pp. 15, 17. As f1095a#1 of the prior review (rechecked): f8962.married_in_2025 asks about a 2025 marriage with coverage before the first full month of marriage; f8962.marriage refuses lines 24 and 25, so the pre-marriage column B rule never meets a computed return.

unruled:f1095a#2.evidence: i8962 p. 16; p974 p. 27. As f1095a#2 and #3 of the prior review (rechecked): f8962.alloc refuses any policy shared with another tax family, so no Part IV allocation of column A arises, and f8962.other ('someone enrolled in a Marketplace policy was not lawfully present in the United States') refuses lines 24 and 25.

unruled:f1095a#3.evidence: i8962 p. 16. As f1095a#2 above, for column B: f8962.alloc refuses shared policies and f8962.other refuses an enrollee not lawfully present.

unruled:f1095a#4.evidence: i8962 p. 17; p974 p. 27. As f1095a#2 of the prior review: f8962.alloc refuses shared policies, and f8962.other ('advance payments were made for someone who is in no one's tax family') refuses lines 24 and 25 when an enrolled individual is in no tax family.

unruled:f2441#1.evidence: i2441 pp. 2, 4; p503 pp. 3, 8, 10. As the earlier f2441#1 ruling, rechecked: dependent.dc_paid states child support, agency reimbursement, chauffeur/bartender/gardener, schooling from kindergarten, overnight camp, summer school and tutoring, food/lodging/education/clothing/entertainment, noncompliant centers, the 8-hour rule for outside care, days of work, mixed-purpose division, the qualifying-person period, housekeeper meals, employment taxes, the medical-expense bar and prepaid care counted in the year received.

unruled:f2441#2.evidence: i2441 pp. 1, 3, "the noncustodial parent can't treat the child as a qualifying person". dependent.divorced_rule asks whether the divorced or separated parents rule applies (custodial or noncustodial) and refuses dependent.qualifying_child; executed on stage15.f2441.s1, it refuses f2441.qp_count and line 11. A disabled dependent must pass dependent.dc_lived_half (dependent.dc_disabled_qp), and a disabled spouse is refused by f2441.student_disabled.

unruled:f4562#1.evidence: i4562 p. 5. f4562.line12 copies the return's Part I (s179): line 5 with the married-filing-separately 50% share and its refusal (s179.line5), the 2024 carryover (s179.line10) and the line 11 business income limit (s179.line11); a trade-in is refused by asset.screen and scveh.screen; asset.s179 requires use in the active conduct of the business.

unruled:f4562#10.evidence: i4562 pp. 14-15. asset.screen refuses listed property whose qualified business use is 50% or less after leaving out investment use, 5% owner and related-person leasing or compensation uses (the quoted exclusions); asset.pct handles conversion months; commuting miles and the section 280F limits are applied in scveh.

unruled:f4562#11.evidence: i4562 pp. 13-15. Line 27 is refused: listed property used 50% or less (asset.listed_low) gates asset.basis.

unruled:f4562#12.evidence: i4562 pp. 5, 13. Line 29 feeds Part I as s179.line7 (person.s179_listed); a section 179 election on property used 50% or less is refused by asset.after179 (asset.s179_bad) and listed property at 50% or less by asset.listed_low.

unruled:f4562#2.evidence: i4562 p. 9. Depreciation is figured on asset.after179 (basis less section 179) after the special allowance; software is refused by asset.screen unless its whole business cost is deducted in 2025 through section 179 and the special allowance; the percentage tables never exceed basis.

unruled:f4562#3.evidence: i4562 p. 9. asset.screen refuses an asset 'you disposed of' in 2025, but does not name the disposition of a portion of an asset, so the basis and reserve reduction for a partial disposition is unasked. Low; BUG-0402.

unruled:f4562#4.evidence: i4562 pp. 9, 11-12. asset.screen refuses like-kind exchanges and involuntary conversions, basis reductions other than section 179 and the special allowance, ADS, straight line and 150% elections, dispositions and short tax years; business use is asset.pct (converted property by months); the mid-quarter test is the mq form.

unruled:f4562#5.evidence: i4562 p. 10. Agricultural asset classes (01.x) map to 'outside' in class_lives (asset.outside, part of asset.screened), and farm income (Schedule F) is refused by scope.schedule1.

unruled:f4562#6.evidence: i4562 p. 11. Smart electric meters and grid systems are named in asset.screen; trees and vines bearing fruits or nuts are farm property (agricultural classes outside; Schedule F refused by scope.schedule1).

unruled:f4562#7.evidence: i4562 p. 12. Farming-business property is outside (agricultural classes 01.x, Schedule F refused by scope.schedule1), and a 150% declining balance election is refused by asset.screen.

unruled:f4562#8.evidence: i4562 pp. 11-13. asset.screen refuses property that must be depreciated under ADS (with examples) and an ADS election, and residential rental and nonresidential real property (real property is refused); Part III Section C is not reached.

unruled:f4562#9.evidence: i4562 pp. 13-14. Listed property used 50% or less is refused (asset.listed_low gates asset.basis); aircraft are refused by asset.screen; vehicles are scveh entries, whose first-year limits include the special allowance (auto_limit tables).

unruled:f4952#1.evidence: f4952 p. 3. As the earlier f4952#1 ruling: f4952.line4d is Schedule D line 16 floored at zero, and Schedule D lines 6 and 14 carry the capital loss carryovers into it. unruled:f5329#1.evidence: i5329 p. 8. As the earlier f5329#4 ruling: f8889.unsupported names 'a withdrawal of excess contributions or their earnings, made in 2025 or in 2026 by the due date of your 2025 return, including extensions' and refuses Form 8889 lines 13 and 16; executed on stage11.hsa_excess with f8889.unsupported true, f5329.l47, l49, s2.line8 and f1040.line24 refuse. A withdrawal after a timely filed return is made on an amended return, not this one.

unruled:f5329#2.evidence: i5329 p. 5. As the earlier f5329#2 ruling: the statement with the child's or eligible adoptee's name, age and TIN (or the death documentation) is an attachment; exception 19 is accepted and its amount computed (fixture stage21.mut.e19).

unruled:f5329#3.evidence: i5329 p. 1. unruled:f5695#1.evidence: i5695 p. 1, Costs, 'costs are treated as being paid when the original installation of the item is completed'. Executed: stage15.f5695.s9 gives s3.line5a $1,225; with part1_any = No (a December 2024 payment), $0. Low.

unruled:f8606#1.evidence: i8606 pp. 2, 9. Covered except one rule: person.ira_trad excludes contributions withdrawn with earnings and employer SEP/SIMPLE contributions; recharacterizations and excess contributions are refused by person.ira_excess. Open: no question adds a repayment of a qualified reservist distribution to line 1. Low; BUG-0402.

unruled:f8606#2.evidence: i8606 p. 2. A traditional IRA distribution with basis from any year (including an inherited IRA) answers 'nondeductible contributions to any traditional IRA' in retirement.special, which refuses it; a Roth IRA distribution other than code Q is refused by retirement.bad_code. So no nontaxable part is left uncomputed.

unruled:f8863#1.evidence: i8863 p. 3, Who cannot claim a credit, '3. You (or your spouse) were a nonresident alien for any part of 2025'. scope.other_income asks for 'Nonresident alien status: you or your spouse, for any part of 2025', and its Yes refuses the return through the scope refusals, so no education credit is computed for such a filer.

unruled:f8863#2.evidence: i8863 p. 1, Form 1098-T requirement (as the earlier f8863#2 ruling, rechecked). dependent.edu_student requires dependent.edu_1098t (person.edu_1098t for the filers), which asks whether a 2025 Form 1098-T was received and states the not-required exceptions and the request-after-February-2-2026, cooperation and substantiation conditions (amb.2025.edu_1098t_date). Scholarship-paid amounts are removed through dependent.edu_a2025 (tax-free part of scholarships, Form 1098-T box 5).

unruled:f8880#1.evidence: f8880 p. 2, Line 2 (as the earlier f8880#1 ruling, rechecked). person.sav_line2 sums person.sav_w2 (box 12 codes D, E, F, S, AA, BB, EE and the governmental 457(b) part of G, so designated Roth deferrals are included), person.sav_voluntary ('Voluntary after-tax employee contributions ... to a qualified retirement plan (including the federal Thrift Savings Plan) ... not contributions designated under section 414(h)(2)') and person.sav_simple; code H (501(c)(18)(D)) is refused by w2.code_h on w2.sav_listed.

unruled:f8889#1.evidence: p969 pp. 4-5; i8889 p. 4 (as the earlier f8889#2 ruling). f8889.coverage_year takes 'covered by an HDHP' at face value (embedded family deductible, plans of mostly disregarded coverage), as BUG-0453 records; the prescription drug plan paying before the deductible and the zero-balance grace-period FSA exception are further HDHP and other-coverage details of the same question, to be added to BUG-0453. The line 1 checkbox is presentation (earlier f8889#3 ruling). Low.

unruled:f8889#2.evidence: p969 p. 5, 'Contributions to an HSA must be made in cash. Contributions of stock or property aren't allowed.' The f8889.line2 question does not exclude non-cash contributions. Pre-existing, low. [Restamped unchanged from the ruling of earlier claim #1 under prompt_sha bf2ae17c: same form, same quoted text, same cited page, same item and effect.]

unruled:f8889#3.evidence: i8889 p. 8, Line 15, 'Do not include the distribution of an excess contribution taken out after the due date, including extensions, of your return even if used for qualified medical expenses'. f8889.medical still lacks this exclusion; BUG-0453 already lists it (open, low).

unruled:f8959#1.evidence: i8959 pp. 1-2, "You must file Form 8959 if". The filing triggers decide only whether the form is attached; lines 1-24 are computed on every return (f8959.line18 to Schedule 2, f8959.line24 to Form 1040 line 25c), so a return that owes no Additional Medicare Tax still gets its withholding credit through line 24.

unruled:f8960#1.evidence: i8960 pp. 17-18, Line 9b (as the earlier f8960#1 ruling, rechecked). A foreign income tax deducted on Schedule A is a Yes to sa.unsupported ('a foreign tax or generation-skipping tax deduction'), which refuses the itemized deduction; line 9b counts only allowed deductions, so without that deduction no foreign tax can be allocated, and f8960.allocated_taxes excludes credited foreign taxes.

unruled:f8962#1.evidence: i8962 pp. 3, 6, 9 (as the earlier f8962#1 ruling). A filer or spouse whom someone can claim as a dependent is refused for the whole return by sa.dependent. The APTC part misreads the encoding: f8962.applicable's estimate branch requires f8962.aptc (advance payments on the Forms 1095-A) together with f8962.estimate_100.

unruled:f8962#2.evidence: i8962 p. 8, Line 1. Removing a filer or spouse who can be claimed as a dependent from the family size arises only on such a return, which sa.dependent ('Can someone claim you or your spouse as a dependent for 2025') refuses for the whole return, standard or itemized.

unruled:f8995#1.evidence: i8995 p. 3. As the earlier f8995#1 ruling: qbi.dividends asks for Form 1099-DIV box 5 dividends 'after confirming holding-period and related-payment requirements', and its interview help repeats the condition; f8995.line6 copies that amount (via qbi.eligible).

unruled:ftc#1.evidence: i1116 p. 2, 'If you are a nonresident alien, you generally can't take the credit.' scope.other_income asks about 'Any nonresident alien status ... you or your spouse, for any part of 2025' and refuses; executed on stage4.ftc.29999 with it true, ftc.credit and f1040.line24 refuse. U.S. Virgin Islands tax on wages (Form W-2VI) is general-category income, so ftc.all_passive is no and ftc.needs1116 refuses the election.

unruled:g28#1.evidence: i1040sd p. 11. sales.special asks about the sale of 'an interest in a partnership, S corporation or trust ... that holds collectibles' and refuses it.

unruled:gift#1.evidence: i8283 p. 3, 'Attach a statement to your tax return showing how you figured the reduction'. The statement is filing information; gift.deduction already asks for the deduction after the reductions, and no amount depends on the statement.

unruled:gift#2.evidence: i8283 pp. 1-2 (as the earlier gift#2 ruling). Whether Form 8283 must be filed above $500, the Section A entries, the SSN and e-file data are filing information that change no amount; gift.over_5000 and gift.special handle the $5,000 Section B threshold by refusal.

unruled:household#1.evidence: p501 pp. 9-10; i1040gi pp. 14, 44. As the earlier household#1 ruling, rechecked: dependent.kidnapped is asked and dependent.kidnap_residency refuses; dependent.hoh_lived_half applies the part-of-year-alive rule for a relative other than a qualifying child; dependent.other_claimant asks whether the child is another person's qualifying child and dependent.qc_tiebreak refuses dependent.qualifying_child, so head of household is not decided on a person another taxpayer can use (the gate's rewrite through dependent.qc_tests keeps the HEAD conditions).

unruled:household#2.evidence: p501 p. 9. As the prior household#1 ruling: Test 1 reads dependent.parent_home_paid, which asks about the parent's main home (a rest home counts) for all of 2025 or the part of the year the parent was alive. Re-ruled on the review rerun after the formal-gate changes (was household#1). [Restamped unchanged from the ruling of earlier claim #2 under prompt_sha 060b0159: same form, same quoted text, same cited page, same item and effect.]

unruled:household#3.evidence: i1040gi p. 13, "Generally, a married couple can't file a joint return if either spouse is a nonresident alien at any time during the year." As earlier rulings: scope.other_income asks about nonresident alien status of you or your spouse for any part of 2025 and refuses the return, so neither the joint-return bar nor the election arises. Re-ruled on the review rerun after the formal-gate changes (was household#5). [Restamped unchanged from the ruling of earlier claim #3 under prompt_sha 060b0159: same form, same quoted text, same cited page, same item and effect.]

unruled:interest#1.evidence: i1040sb pp. 1-2. The interest roster's help names accrued market discount (taxable even on a tax-exempt bond) and contingent payment debt instrument gain; sb.unsupported names them and refuses; tax-exempt interest is asked separately (f1040.tax_exempt_interest).

unruled:interest#2.evidence: i1040sb p. 1. The roster's help names seller-financed interest; the buyer's name, address and SSN and the listing order are filing information; sb.unsupported names seller-financed mortgage interest and refuses.

unruled:ira#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 96. unruled:refund#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 89; p525 p. 24. unruled:retirement#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 27. As the earlier retirement#1 ruling: the statement explaining a rollover into a qualified plan, or one made in 2026, is an attachment; the amount rolled over within 60 days is asked (retirement.rollover) and excluded.

unruled:retirement#2.evidence: p575 p. 21. unruled:retirement#3.evidence: i5329 p. 5. As the earlier retirement#4 ruling: the statement with the child's or eligible adoptee's name, age and TIN (or the death documentation) is an attachment; exception 19 is accepted and its amount computed.

unruled:s1#1.evidence: p525 p. 35. The NHSC, HPSP and work-college exceptions only narrow the omitted rule.

unruled:s1#2.evidence: p504 p. 14, 'Your spouse can exclude the payments from income only if they attach a copy of the instrument designating them as not alimony to their return.' s1.alimony_received excludes 'payments your divorce or separation instrument designates as not alimony'; attaching the copy each year is filing information. unruled:s1#3.evidence: i1040gi p. 93. person.eligible_educator asks the 900-hour K-12 test word for word, and person.educator_expenses excludes 'home schooling or nonathletic supplies for courses in health or physical education' and is 'reduced by excludable savings bond interest (Form 8815), nontaxable qualified tuition program or Coverdell earnings or distributions, and reimbursements not reported in box 1 of your Form W-2'.

unruled:s179#1.evidence: p946 pp. 17-18; i4562 p. 5. unruled:s179#2.evidence: p946 pp. 18-19. [Restamped unchanged from the ruling of earlier claim #3 under prompt_sha 1ca63238: same form, same quoted text, same cited page, same item and effect.]

unruled:s179#3.evidence: p946 p. 19, "Net income or loss from a trade or business includes the following items. ... Interest from working capital of your trade or business." unruled:s1a#1.evidence: i1040gi pp. 101-103. [Restamped unchanged from the ruling of earlier claim #1 under prompt_sha c1e801ce: same form, same quoted text, same cited page, same item and effect.]

unruled:s2#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 112; i1040sse p. 2. unruled:s8812#1.evidence: i1040gi pp. 17-18; i1040s8812 p. 1. unruled:s8812#2.evidence: i1040gi p. 19; i1040s8812 p. 2. unruled:s8812#3.evidence: i1040s8812 p. 3. As the earlier s8812#3 ruling: person.se_screen names "electing an optional method (Schedule SE Part II)", farm or nonfarm, and person.se_screened refuses Schedule SE and the earned income built on it; treaty-excluded income is a Schedule 1 line 8 exclusion refused by s1.line8_other.

unruled:sa#1.evidence: i1040sca p. 8 (as the earlier sa#1 ruling). sa.line8a asks only for 'Eligible home mortgage interest and points on Form 1098'; the co-borrower share, the refund-of-overpaid-interest rule, prepaid interest and the basic-living-accommodations home test are recorded in BUG-0459 (open, low). Interest larger than Form 1098 shows is 'mortgage interest ... not on Form 1098', refused by sa.unsupported, as are proceeds not used to buy, build or improve the home.

unruled:sa#2.evidence: i1040gi p. 33. sa.boxes_blind counts person.blind, whose question says 'answer yes only if you have a statement certified by your eye doctor (ophthalmologist or optometrist) that you can't see better than 20/200 in your better eye ... or that your field of vision is 20 degrees or less' when not totally blind.

unruled:sales#1.evidence: i8949 pp. 5, 11; i1040sd p. 5. A contingent payment debt instrument and accrued market discount are named only in sb.unsupported, which is asked only when taxable interest, ordinary dividends or capital gain distributions are above zero (sb.unsupported_if_income); sales.code and sales.special do not ask about them or the Ordinary box. Executed sales.box.D (no Schedule B income) with sb.unsupported true: no refusal, sd.line16 and f1040.line7a $4,000 capital gain, f1040.line2b $0. Witness: a tax-exempt bond bought at a market discount and sold at a gain.

unruled:sales#2.evidence: p550 p. 81; i1040sd p. 6, 'You report this type of ordinary loss on Form 4797, Part II, line 10.' As the earlier sales#2 ruling: sd.other_forms asks about 'gains or losses from (or that belong on) Forms 4797 ...' and refuses (executed on sales.box.D: sd.line16 refuses), which takes in section 1244 and SBIC stock losses.

unruled:sales#3.evidence: i1040sd pp. 5-6. As the earlier sales#2 ruling: a section 475(f) trader's gains and losses (Form 4797 Part II) and an installment sale (Form 6252) belong on forms that sd.other_forms names ('Forms 4797, 2439, 6252 ...') and refuses.

unruled:sb#1.evidence: i1040sb pp. 2-3. As the earlier sb#1 ruling: sb.line7a is a yes/no box whose only use is the Part III notice (sb.partIII, with sb.line4, sb.line6 and sb.line8); no amount depends on it. The account definitions and the signature-authority instruction affect only that answer.

unruled:sc#1.evidence: i1040sc pp. 6-7, 15. As the earlier sc#1 ruling, rechecked: scveh.smr_ok asks the first-year, whole-lease-period and five-vehicle rules and scveh.smr_bad refuses; scveh.lease_smr_bad refuses actual expenses on a leased vehicle after the standard rate; depreciation and lease payments reach lines 13 and 20a only on the actual-expense branches (scveh.is_actual_owned, scveh.is_actual_leased); scveh.miles_commuting carries the converted-vehicle rule. The statement for additional vehicles is filing information.

unruled:sc#2.evidence: i1040sc p. 13, "You can't deduct any depreciation ... for the portion of your home" with the simplified method. A home is real property, which asset.screen names ("it is real property (a building or a structural component, other than qualified improvement property) or land") and asset.screened refuses, so no home depreciation or section 179 can reach line 13.

unruled:sc#3.evidence: i1040sc p. 14, "Use Part II of Schedule C to deduct business expenses that are unrelated to the qualified business use of the home"; p. 10, the simplified method replaces actual expenses. sc.line16a, sc.line16b and sc.line23 exclude home mortgage interest and real estate taxes, but sc.line25 ("Utility expenses of the business only"), sc.line20b ("Rent for other business property, such as office space"), sc.line15 and sc.line21 do not exclude the home's share. Executed stage14.ho.basic with $600 of home utilities on line 25: line 30 $1,000 and line 31 $18,400, where the source gives $19,000.

unruled:sc#4.evidence: i1040sc p. 1, "use Form 461 to determine the amount of your excess business loss". s1.line3 refuses (Form 461) when s1.ebl_loss, the net loss of all Schedules C on the return, exceeds s1.ebl_threshold ($313,000; $626,000 joint, rp-2024-40 section 3.32); other business income and losses that enter Form 461 (Schedule E, F, Form 4797) are refused by scope.schedule1, and wages do not enter it.

unruled:scope#1.evidence: p575 p. 35. retirement.special names 'a qualified disaster recovery distribution (whatever the code in box 7), or a repayment of one, or a recontribution of a distribution to purchase or construct a main home that was canceled because of a qualified disaster (Form 8915-F)' (BUG-0408) and refuses the distribution's taxable amount; scope.other_income asks the 2023 and 2024 parts and repayments.

unruled:scope#2.evidence: i1040sse p. 1. As scope#3 of the refresh round: person.se_screen names an approved Form 4029 or Form 4361 and refuses Schedule SE.

unruled:scope#3.evidence: i1040gi p. 36; i8960 p. 22. s1.line8_other asks about 'the foreign earned income or housing exclusion from Form 2555 (8d)' and refuses f1040.line8; sa.excluded_income refuses the EIC for a Form 2555 filer. unruled:scveh#1.evidence: i1040sc p. 8; p946 p. 59. As the earlier scveh#1 ruling, rechecked: sc.special lists "an inclusion amount for leased property" and sc.screened refuses the business at sc.line1.

unruled:sd#1.evidence: i1040sd p. 10. As the earlier ruling: a 2025 separate return is refused (s3.mfs). [Restamped unchanged from the ruling of earlier claim #1 under prompt_sha b6203d10: same form, same quoted text, same cited page, same item and effect.]

unruled:u1250#1.evidence: i1040sd p. 13. sales.special asks about the sale of an interest in a partnership that holds section 1250 property and refuses it.

unruled:w2#1.evidence: i8959 p. 1. As the earlier w2#1 ruling, rechecked: w2.box5 feeds only person.medicare5 and Form 8959 line 1, and f8959.unsupported names "Medicare wages on a wage statement from a U.S. territory (such as Form 499R-2/W-2PR)" and refuses Form 8959.

unruled:w2#5.evidence: i2441 p. 5. As w2#4 of the refresh round: s8812.combat_pay asks about nontaxable combat pay and refuses Form 2441 lines 4, 5, 18 and 19. unruled:person#3.evidence: p560 p. 16, Employer matching contributions: "If you choose a matching contribution less than 3%, the percentage must be at least 1%". person.employer_max allows matching up to 3% of compensation, the plan's maximum; a plan that elected a lower match for 2025 makes any matching above that rate more than the deductible amount, and person.plan_screen asks whether there are "contributions that are more than the maximum deductible amount" and person.plan_screened refuses the person's retirement lines on Yes. unruled:sc#6.evidence: i1040sc p. 5. As the earlier sc#5 ruling: the Form 1099-NEC difference statement is filing information. [Restamped unchanged from the ruling of earlier claim #3 under prompt_sha 8dea2914: same form, same quoted text, same cited page, same item and effect.]

unruled:sc#7.evidence: i1040sc p. 8. As the earlier sc#6 ruling: the statements and margin notations for lines 16a and 16b are filing information; the interest is entered. unruled:f2441#3.evidence: i2441 p. 3; p503 p. 3. unruled:f2441#4.evidence: i2441 p. 3, enter "Tax-Exempt" or "LAFCP" in column (c), and "none" on line 1 when filing only for Part III. These are entries on the form that change no amount; the provider TIN kinds tax_exempt and lafcp are already asked by dcprov.tin_kind.

unruled:s1a#2.evidence: i1040gi p. 103, "Do not include tips received in occupations that are not included on this list in line 4a, 4b, or 4c." tipjob.qualified asks, for each employer, "Were all the tips you are counting from this employer received in an occupation on the IRS list of occupations that customarily and regularly received tips on or before December 31, 2024"; No refuses through tipjob.mixed ("Splitting one employer's reported tips between qualified and nonqualified tips is outside this tool"), so an employer's amount that mixes listed and unlisted occupations cannot reach line 4a.

unruled:s1a#3.evidence: i1040gi p. 109. unruled:s1a#4.evidence: i1040gi pp. 109-110. s1a.line23_total sums carloan.col_iii, which subtracts carloan.col_ii (the Schedule C part, carloan.col_ii_input; Schedules E and F are refused by scope.schedule1); carloan.mixed/nonqualifying exclude negative equity, insurance and trailers, and carloan.refi_balance limits a refinancing to the balance at refinancing. unruled:sc#5.evidence: i1040sc p. 10, "You can't use the simplified method to figure a deduction for rental use of your home." unruled:sc#8.evidence: i1040sc pp. 3-5, lines A, B, E, H and I. The business description and code, address, the started-or-acquired box and the Forms 1099 question are header entries that change no amount.

unruled:scveh#3.evidence: i4562 p. 16, Part V Section B lines 30-36; i1040sc p. 7. unruled:ftc#2.evidence: i1116 p. 2, 'if you take the credit for any eligible foreign taxes, you can't take any part of that year's foreign taxes as a deduction.' unruled:s1#4.evidence: i1040gi pp. 98-99; p4681 p. 5. unruled:sales#4.evidence: p550 p. 82. As the earlier sales#3 ruling: sd.other_forms names Form 6781 and says 'Count section 1256 contracts', and refuses Schedule D, so a section 1256 contract is not classified by holding period.

unruled:sales#5.evidence: i8949 p. 6, 'If you don't use the actual cost, attach an explanation of your basis.' The explanation is an attachment; sales.correct_basis already asks the non-cost basis rules that fix the amount.

unruled:clcw26#2.evidence: p550 p. 103; i1040sd p. 10. A 2025 separate return is refused (s3.mfs, through scope); separate 2024 carryovers combined on a 2025 joint return, and a joint 2024 carryover with someone other than the 2025 spouse, are refused by clcw.spouse_screen. Which spouse had the loss matters only on a 2026 separate return, outside this tax year; the 2025 joint figure on clcw26.line8/line13 is correct for the 2025 joint return.

unruled:clcw26#3.evidence: i1040sd p. 10, 'If you excluded canceled debt from income in 2025, see Pub. 4681' (as the earlier clcw26#1 ruling). A canceled debt 'otherwise excluded from income (Form 982 ...)' is a Yes to s1.cod_unsupported, which refuses s1.cod_refused, reached from s1.line8c whenever s1.cod_any is Yes and an amount is entered; so no return with excluded canceled debt (and its attribute reduction) is computed.

unruled:f8863#3.evidence: i8863 pp. 1, 3, 8 (as the earlier f8863#1 ruling, rechecked). dependent.edu_aoc ends in dependent.edu_aoc_tin, which requires household.all_tin (both filers, amb.2025.edu_filer_tin) and dependent.edu_ein (the institution's EIN); person.edu_aoc_tin likewise. An ITIN applied for by the due date counts, which the fixtures f1.t113.dep_aoc_applied and f1.t113.person_aoc_itin_applied tie to p970 p. 11 (an ITIN issued on that application is considered issued by the due date).

unruled:f8880#2.evidence: f8880 p. 2, Who Can Take This Credit. person.sav_student, read by person.sav_ineligible (and so f8880.inelig_a / inelig_b), asks 'during any part of 5 calendar months of 2025, were you enrolled as a full-time student at a school, or did you take a full-time, on-farm training course ...' and excludes on-the-job training courses, correspondence schools and Internet-only schools, word for word.

unruled:person#6.evidence: i8863 pp. 1, 3. As the earlier person#3 ruling: f8863.ban asks about a post-2015 denial or reduction needing Form 8862 and the 2-year and 10-year bans for the return's American opportunity credit, and f8863.ban_refused refuses line 7 (stage19.example.jack_kay, f8863.ban true refuses f8863.line7, line8 and f1040.line29).

unruled:person#7.evidence: i1040gi p. 95 (reservist repayments not deductible); i8606 p. 9, "Include on line 1 any repayment of a qualified reservist distribution". As the earlier person#2 ruling: scope.other_income lists "a repayment to an IRA of a qualified reservist distribution (Form 8606 line 1)" and refuses the return, so no such repayment reaches person.ira_trad.
